text:
kayla: Heads up — onboarding reported confusion: quickstarts check numeric status codes directly (e.g. `if (err.status === 429)`) and people end up writing brittle retries. Can we settle on typed SDK errors + a small retry_hint to teach correct patterns?

mike: +1. Current problem: infra sometimes includes `Retry-After` header, sometimes a `retry_hint` in JSON body. SDKs need a canonical mapping so sample apps are consistent.

sofia: Proposal: SDK error surface = typed classes (RateLimitError, AuthError, PermissionError, ServerError, ClientError) with these fields/methods exposed: `retryHint` (string enum), `retryAfter` (number|null), `httpStatus` (int), and `raw` (body + headers). Keeps app code simple.

tomas: For Go, prefer interface methods: `RetryHint() string`, `RetryAfter() time.Duration`, `HTTPStatus() int`, plus helper funcs `IsRetryable(err error) bool` and `RetryAfterOrDefault(err error, d time.Duration) time.Duration`. Will need to parse `Retry-After` both as seconds and as HTTP-date.

kayla: Thinking about mapping rules for docs: 
```
401 -> AuthError (retryHint: refresh-token if using bearer)
403 -> PermissionError (no-retry)
429 -> RateLimitError (prefer explicit retry_hint in body; else parse header; else exponential)
5xx -> ServerError (exponential)
other 4xx -> ClientError (no-retry)
```
We should also be explicit about `Retry-After: 0` meaning try immediately (not no-retry).

mike: Edge case: we sometimes return a JSON envelope like `{ code, message, http_status, retry_hint }`. If `retry_hint` is present prefer it over header heuristics. Good for progressive rollout.

sofia: Tests we need: parse numeric `Retry-After: 120`, parse HTTP-date `Retry-After: Tue, 15 Nov 1994 08:12:31 GMT`, body `retry_hint: exponential`, and missing header+body fallback to heuristic. Add unit tests across ts/go/py.

tomas: I'll open a small go PR that exports concrete error types (RateLimitError, AuthError) and implements the helper funcs. Also add an example in sample-apps showing recommended pattern: `if IsRetryable(err) { wait := RetryAfterOrDefault(err, backoffEstimate()); sleep(wait) }`.

ci-bot: ci/go-sdk #902 failed: tests/retry_parse_test.go:12 -> expected retry_hint "retry-after" but got "none". Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/go-sdk/902

mike: Looks like the test harness mock didn't include headers. Tomas, can you update the mock server to return headers and body variants?

tomas: On it. I'll add three small mocks and a smoke sample-app that demonstrates reading `err.retryHint`.

kayla: Once merged, we'll update onboarding quickstarts: show `instanceof RateLimitError` (TS), `except RateLimitError as e` (py), and the Go helpers pattern. Also add a lint rule in sample-apps to flag direct `err.status === 429` checks and recommend `IsRetryable`/`instanceof`.

sofia: Small UX thought: SDKs should include `rawMessage` or `rawBody` for quick support debugging so users can paste logs into support tickets. Keep human-facing message concise and machine fields explicit.

mike: Agreed. Tomas, drop the PR link here when ready and include tests for `Retry-After: 0`.

tomas: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/go-sdk/pulls/489 — implements typed errors + Retry-After parsing + helpers + tests.

ci-bot: merge pipeline started for PR 489.

kayla: Awesome. This should reduce onboarding friction a lot. Thanks team! :tada:
